title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
summary: That means new information from locked chats won’t leak into regular chats. Additionally, the Locked Chats option isn’t available for temporary chats, archived chats, group chats, chats created from a shared link, chats with scheduled tasks, and chats with meeting recordings.
